WITH CustomerOrderCount AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
    HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 2
),
CustomerItemCount AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        SUM(COUNT(oi.order_item_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id) AS total_items
    FROM Orders o
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
    HAVING SUM(COUNT(oi.order_item_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id) >= 3
)
SELECT 
    coc.customer_id,
    c.customer_first_name,
    c.customer_last_name
FROM CustomerOrderCount coc
JOIN CustomerItemCount cic ON coc.customer_id = cic.customer_id
JOIN Customers c ON coc.customer_id = c.customer_id;

SELECT

JOIN

JOIN

    c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 2 AND COUNT(oi.order_item_id) >= 3;

WITH OrderCounts AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM Orders o
    GROUP BY o.customer_id

    SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS item_count

)

JOIN ItemCounts ic ON c.customer_id = ic.customer_id

WITH OrderCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        c.gender_code,
        COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders
    FROM 
        Customers c
    LEFT JOIN 
        Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY 
        c.gender_code
),
MinOrderGender AS (
    SELECT 
        gender_code
    FROM 
        OrderCounts
    ORDER BY 
        total_orders ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    c.email_address,
    c.town_city,
    c.county
FROM 
    Customers c
JOIN 
    MinOrderGender mog ON c.gender_code = mog.gender_code;

WITH GenderOrders AS (
    SELECT 
        C.gender_code,
        COUNT(O.order_id) AS total_orders
    FROM 
        Customers C
    JOIN 
        Orders O ON C.customer_id = O.customer_id
    GROUP BY 
        C.gender_code
),

LeastFrequentGender AS (
    SELECT 
        gender_code
    FROM 
        GenderOrders
    WHERE 
        total_orders = (SELECT MIN(total_orders) FROM GenderOrders)
)

SELECT 
    C.email_address,
    C.town_city,
    C.county
FROM 
    Customers C
JOIN 
    LeastFrequentGender LFG ON C.gender_code = LFG.gender_code;

        GROUP BY c.gender_code

);

    FROM

)

    SELECT DISTINCT s.Service_Details
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Customer_Interactions ci ON c.Customer_ID = ci.Customer_ID

    WHERE c.Customer_Details = 'Hardy Kutch'
),

    SELECT DISTINCT s.Service_Details
    FROM Customer_Interactions ci
    JOIN Services s ON ci.Service_ID = s.Service_ID

)

    SELECT cs.Service_ID

)

SELECT s.bio_data, s.student_details
FROM Students s
JOIN Achievements a ON s.student_id = a.student_id
WHERE a.achievement_details IN (
    SELECT achievement_details
    FROM Achievements
    GROUP BY achievement_details
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
AND a.achievement_details IN (
    SELECT achievement_details
    FROM Achievements
    GROUP BY achievement_details
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 3
);

SELECT s.bio_data, s.student_details
FROM Students s
WHERE s.student_id IN (
    SELECT a.student_id
    FROM Achievements a
    WHERE a.achievement_details = (
        SELECT achievement_details
        FROM Achievements
        GROUP BY achievement_details
        ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
)
AND s.student_id IN (
    SELECT b.student_id
    FROM Achievements a
    JOIN Behaviour_Monitoring b ON a.student_id = b.student_id
    WHERE a.achievement_details = (
        SELECT achievement_details
        FROM Achievements
        JOIN Behaviour_Monitoring b ON Achievements.student_id = b.student_id
        GROUP BY achievement_details
        HAVING COUNT(*) = 3
    )
);

WITH CommonResults AS (
    SELECT 
        se.student_id,
        COUNT(*) AS result_count
    FROM 
        Student_Events se
    INNER JOIN 
        Ref_Event_Types ret ON se.event_type_code = ret.event_type_code
    WHERE 
        ret.event_type_description LIKE 'Test%'
    GROUP BY 
        se.student_id
    ORDER BY 
        result_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
ThreeStudentsResult AS (
    SELECT 
        se.student_id,
        COUNT(*) AS result_count
    FROM 
        Student_Events se
    INNER JOIN 
        Ref_Event_Types ret ON se.event_type_code = ret.event_type_code
    WHERE 
        ret.event_type_description LIKE 'Test%'
    GROUP BY 
        se.student_id
    HAVING 
        result_count = 3
)
SELECT 
    s.bio_data,
    s.student_details
FROM 
    Students s
INNER JOIN 
    CommonResults cr ON s.student_id = cr.student_id
INNER JOIN 
    ThreeStudentsResult tsr ON s.student_id = tsr.student_id;

WITH TopResultsCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        achievement_type_code, 
        COUNT(student_id) AS student_count
    FROM 
        Achievements
    GROUP BY 
        achievement_type_code
    ORDER BY 
        student_count DESC
),
FilteredTopResultsCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        tr.achievement_type_code
    FROM 
        TopResultsCTE tr
    WHERE 
        tr.student_count = 3
)
SELECT 
    s.bio_data, 
    s.student_details
FROM 
    Students s
JOIN 
    Achievements a ON s.student_id = a.student_id
JOIN 
    FilteredTopResultsCTE ftr ON a.achievement_type_code = ftr.achievement_type_code;

WITH MostCommonResult AS (
    SELECT 
        behaviour_monitoring_details AS most_common_result
    FROM 
        Behaviour_Monitoring
    GROUP BY 
        behaviour_monitoring_details
    ORDER BY 
        COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
ResultsByThreeStudents AS (
    SELECT 
        behaviour_monitoring_details AS result_by_three_students
    FROM 
        Behaviour_Monitoring
    GROUP BY 
        behaviour_monitoring_details
    HAVING 
        COUNT(*) = 3
)
SELECT 
    s.bio_data, 
    s.student_details
FROM 
    Students s
JOIN 
    Behaviour_Monitoring bm ON s.student_id = bm.student_id
JOIN 
    MostCommonResult mcr ON bm.behaviour_monitoring_details = mcr.most_common_result
JOIN 
    ResultsByThreeStudents rts ON bm.behaviour_monitoring_details = rts.result_by_three_students;

SELECT s.student_id, s.bio_data, s.student_details
FROM Students s
WHERE s.student_id IN (
    SELECT sm.student_id
    FROM Behaviour_Monitoring sm
    GROUP BY sm.student_id
    HAVING COUNT(sm.behaviour_monitoring_id) = 3
)
AND s.student_id IN (
    SELECT st.student_id
    FROM Student_Events se
    WHERE se.event_type_code = 'MostCommonResult'
    GROUP BY st.student_id
    HAVING COUNT(st.event_id) = (
        SELECT COUNT(event_id)
        FROM Student_Events
        WHERE event_type_code = 'MostCommonResult'
        GROUP BY student_id
        ORDER BY COUNT(student_id) DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
);

WITH AchievementCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        a.student_id,
        r.achievement_type_description,
        COUNT(a.student_id) OVER (PARTITION BY r.achievement_type_description) as achievement_count
    FROM 
        Achievements a
    JOIN 
        Ref_Achievement_Type r ON a.achievement_type_code = r.achievement_type_code
),
MostCommonAchievement AS (
    SELECT 
        achievement_type_description
    FROM 
        AchievementCounts
    GROUP BY 
        achievement_type_description
    ORDER BY 
        MAX(achievement_count) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
ThreeStudentAchievements AS (
    SELECT 
        achievement_type_description
    FROM 
        AchievementCounts
    WHERE 
        achievement_count = 3
)
SELECT 
    s.bio_data,
    s.student_details
FROM 
    Students s
JOIN 
    Achievements a ON s.student_id = a.student_id
JOIN 
    Ref_Achievement_Type r ON a.achievement_type_code = r.achievement_type_code
WHERE 
    r.achievement_type_description IN (SELECT achievement_type_description FROM MostCommonAchievement)
AND 
    r.achievement_type_description IN (SELECT achievement_type_description FROM ThreeStudentAchievements);

SELECT s.bio_data, s.student_details
FROM Students s
JOIN (
    SELECT student_id
    FROM Achievements
    GROUP BY student_id, achievement_type_code
    HAVING COUNT(*) = (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM Achievements
        GROUP BY achievement_type_code
        ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
) a ON s.student_id = a.student_id
JOIN (
    SELECT student_id
    FROM Behaviour_Monitoring
    GROUP BY student_id, achievement_type_code
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 3
) b ON s.student_id = b.student_id;

SELECT 
    s.bio_data, 
    s.student_details
FROM 
    Students s
JOIN 
    Behaviour_Monitoring b ON s.student_id = b.student_id
WHERE 
    b.behaviour_monitoring_details IN (
        SELECT 
            behaviour_monitoring_details
        FROM 
            Behaviour_Monitoring
        GROUP BY 
            behaviour_monitoring_details
        ORDER BY 
            COUNT(*) DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
AND 
    b.behaviour_monitoring_details IN (
        SELECT 
            behaviour_monitoring_details
        FROM 
            Behaviour_Monitoring
        GROUP BY 
            behaviour_monitoring_details
        HAVING 
            COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) = 3
    );

WITH EventCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        e.event_type_code,
        COUNT(*) as event_count
    FROM 
        Student_Events e
    GROUP BY 
        e.event_type_code
    ORDER BY 
        event_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),

BehaveCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        bm.behaviour_monitoring_details,
        COUNT(DISTINCT bm.student_id) as student_count
    FROM 
        Behaviour_Monitoring bm
    GROUP BY 
        bm.behaviour_monitoring_details
    HAVING 
        student_count = 3
)

SELECT 
    s.bio_data,
    s.student_details
FROM 
    Students s
WHERE 
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Student_Events se
        JOIN EventCounts ec ON se.event_type_code = ec.event_type_code
        WHERE se.student_id = s.student_id
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Behaviour_Monitoring bm
        JOIN BehaveCounts bc ON bm.behaviour_monitoring_details = bc.behaviour_monitoring_details
        WHERE bm.student_id = s.student_id
    );

WITH Student_Achievements AS (
    SELECT 
        s.student_id,
        s.bio_data,
        s.student_details,
        a.achievement_type_code,
        COUNT(a.student_id) OVER (PARTITION BY a.student_id, a.achievement_type_code) AS achievement_count
    FROM 
        Students s
    JOIN 
        Achievements a ON s.student_id = a.student_id
),
Common_Achievements AS (
    SELECT 
        sa.student_id,
        sa.bio_data,
        sa.student_details,
        sa.achievement_type_code,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sa.student_id ORDER BY sa.achievement_count DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        Student_Achievements sa
),
Filtered_Achievements AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.student_id,
        ca.bio_data,
        ca.student_details,
        ca.achievement_type_code
    FROM 
        Common_Achievements ca
    WHERE 
        ca.rank = 1
),
Student_Behaviour_Counts AS (
    SELECT 
        bm.student_id,
        bm.behaviour_monitoring_details,
        COUNT(bm.student_id) AS monitoring_count
    FROM 
        Behaviour_Monitoring bm
    GROUP BY 
        bm.student_id, bm.behaviour_monitoring_details
)
SELECT 
    fa.bio_data,
    fa.student_details
FROM 
    Filtered_Achievements fa
JOIN 
    Student_Behaviour_Counts sbc ON fa.student_id = sbc.student_id AND fa.achievement_type_code = sbc.behaviour_monitoring_details
WHERE 
    sbc.monitoring_count = 3;

SELECT s.student_id, s.bio_data, s.student_details
FROM Students s
WHERE s.student_id IN (
    SELECT student_id
    FROM Behaviour_Monitoring
    GROUP BY student_id
    HAVING COUNT(student_id) = 3
);

WITH Student_Behaviour_Count AS (
    SELECT 
        bm.student_id,
        bm.behaviour_monitoring_details,
        COUNT(*) AS detail_count
    FROM 
        Behaviour_Monitoring bm
    GROUP BY 
        bm.student_id, bm.behaviour_monitoring_details
),
Student_Most_Common_Detail AS (
    SELECT 
        sbc.student_id,
        sbc.behaviour_monitoring_details,
        sbc.detail_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sbc.student_id ORDER BY sbc.detail_count DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        Student_Behaviour_Count sbc
),
Filtered_Students AS (
    SELECT 
        smcd.student_id
    FROM 
        Student_Most_Common_Detail smcd
    WHERE 
        smcd.rn = 1 AND smcd.detail_count = 1
)
SELECT 
    s.bio_data
FROM 
    Filtered_Students fs
JOIN 
    Students s ON fs.student_id = s.student_id;

WITH MostCommonResult AS (
    SELECT 
        behaviour_monitoring_details
    FROM 
        Behaviour_Monitoring
    GROUP BY 
        behaviour_monitoring_details
    ORDER BY 
        COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
FilteredStudents AS (
    SELECT 
        s.student_id,
        s.bio_data
    FROM 
        Students s
    JOIN 
        MostCommonResult mcr ON s.student_id IN (
            SELECT 
                student_id
            FROM 
                Behaviour_Monitoring
            WHERE 
                behaviour_monitoring_details = mcr.behaviour_monitoring_details
        )
    GROUP BY 
        s.student_id, s.bio_data
    HAVING 
        COUNT(DISTINCT bm.behaviour_monitoring_details) = 1
)
SELECT 
    fs.bio_data
FROM 
    FilteredStudents fs;

WITH BehaviorCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        student_id, 
        behaviour_monitoring_details, 
        COUNT(*) AS detail_count
    FROM 
        Behaviour_Monitoring
    GROUP BY 
        student_id, 
        behaviour_monitoring_details
),
BehaviorRanks AS (
    SELECT 
        bc.student_id, 
        bc.behaviour_monitoring_details, 
        bc.detail_count,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY bc.student_id ORDER BY bc.detail_count DESC) AS rank_by_detail
    FROM 
        BehaviorCounts bc
)
SELECT DISTINCT s.bio_data
FROM 
    BehaviorRanks br
JOIN 
    Students s ON br.student_id = s.student_id
WHERE 
    br.rank_by_detail = 1;

WITH MostCommonDetail AS (
    SELECT 
        behaviour_monitoring_details
    FROM 
        Behaviour_Monitoring
    GROUP BY 
        behaviour_monitoring_details
    ORDER BY 
        COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    s.bio_data
FROM 
    Students s
JOIN 
    Behaviour_Monitoring b ON s.student_id = b.student_id
WHERE 
    b.behaviour_monitoring_details = (SELECT behaviour_monitoring_details FROM MostCommonDetail);

WITH StudentMonitoringCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        bm.student_id,
        bm.behaviour_monitoring_details,
        COUNT(*) AS detail_count
    FROM 
        Behaviour_Monitoring bm
    GROUP BY 
        bm.student_id,
        bm.behaviour_monitoring_details
),
StudentMaxDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        smc.student_id,
        MAX(smc.detail_count) AS max_detail_count
    FROM 
        StudentMonitoringCounts smc
    GROUP BY 
        smc.student_id
),
FilteredStudents AS (
    SELECT 
        smc.student_id
    FROM 
        StudentMonitoringCounts smc
    JOIN 
        StudentMaxDetails smd ON smc.student_id = smd.student_id AND smc.detail_count = smd.max_detail_count
    GROUP BY 
        smc.student_id
    HAVING 
        COUNT(DISTINCT smc.behaviour_monitoring_details) = 1
)
SELECT 
    s.bio_data
FROM 
    Students s
JOIN 
    FilteredStudents fs ON s.student_id = fs.student_id;

SELECT s.bio_data
FROM Students s
JOIN Behaviour_Monitoring bm ON s.student_id = bm.student_id
GROUP BY s.student_id
HAVING bm.behaviour_monitoring_details = (
    SELECT bm2.behaviour_monitoring_details
    FROM Behaviour_Monitoring bm2
    WHERE bm2.student_id = s.student_id
    GROUP BY bm2.behaviour_monitoring_details
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT s.bio_data
FROM Students s
JOIN Behaviour_Monitoring b ON s.student_id = b.student_id
WHERE b.behaviour_monitoring_details = (
    SELECT bm.behaviour_monitoring_details
    FROM Behaviour_Monitoring bm
    GROUP BY bm.behaviour_monitoring_details
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT s.bio_data
FROM Students s
JOIN Behaviour_Monitoring b ON s.student_id = b.student_id
WHERE b.behaviour_monitoring_details = (
    SELECT bmd.behaviour_monitoring_details
    FROM Behaviour_Monitoring bmd
    GROUP BY bmd.behaviour_monitoring_details
    ORDER BY COUNT(bmd.behaviour_monitoring_details) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

WITH CommonDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        behaviour_monitoring_details,
        COUNT(*) AS detail_count
    FROM 
        Behaviour_Monitoring
    GROUP BY 
        behaviour_monitoring_details
    ORDER BY 
        detail_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

-- Step 2: Get the biographical information of students with the most common details
SELECT 
    s.bio_data
FROM 
    Students s
JOIN 
    Behaviour_Monitoring b ON s.student_id = b.student_id
JOIN 
    CommonDetails cd ON b.behaviour_monitoring_details = cd.behaviour_monitoring_details;

SELECT s.bio_data
FROM Students s
JOIN (
    SELECT student_id
    FROM Behaviour_Monitoring
    GROUP BY student_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) bm ON s.student_id = bm.student_id;

SELECT s.bio_data
FROM Students s
JOIN (
    SELECT student_id
    FROM Behaviour_Monitoring
    WHERE behaviour_monitoring_details = (
        SELECT behaviour_monitoring_details
        FROM Behaviour_Monitoring
        GROUP BY behaviour_monitoring_details
        ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
) bm ON s.student_id = bm.student_id;

SELECT s.bio_data 
FROM Students s
JOIN Behaviour_Monitoring bm ON s.student_id = bm.student_id
GROUP BY s.student_id, bm.behaviour_monitoring_details
ORDER BY COUNT(bm.behaviour_monitoring_details) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.bio_data AS student_bio_data,
    se.event_date AS event_date
FROM 
    Students s
JOIN 
    Student_Events se ON s.student_id = se.student_id;

SELECT 
    s.bio_data AS student_bio_data,
    se.event_date AS event_occurrence_date
FROM 
    Students s
INNER JOIN 
    Student_Events se ON s.student_id = se.student_id;

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS student_count, 
    e.event_type_code, 
    r.event_type_description
FROM 
    Student_Events e
JOIN 
    Ref_Event_Types r ON e.event_type_code = r.event_type_code
GROUP BY 
    e.event_type_code
ORDER BY 
    student_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(se.student_id) AS NumberOfStudents, 
       se.event_type_code AS EventTypeCode, 
       ret.event_type_description AS EventTypeDescription
FROM Student_Events se
JOIN Ref_Event_Types ret ON se.event_type_code = ret.event_type_code
GROUP BY se.event_type_code
ORDER BY NumberOfStudents DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH EventCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        e.event_type_code, 
        t.event_type_description, 
        COUNT(e.student_id) AS total_students
    FROM 
        Student_Events e
    JOIN 
        Ref_Event_Types t ON e.event_type_code = t.event_type_code
    GROUP BY 
        e.event_type_code, t.event_type_description
),
RankedEventCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        event_type_code, 
        event_type_description, 
        total_students, 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_students DESC) as rank
    FROM 
        EventCounts
)
SELECT 
    total_students, 
    event_type_code, 
    event_type_description
FROM 
    RankedEventCounts
WHERE 
    rank = 1;

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_students,
    se.event_type_code,
    ret.event_type_description
FROM 
    Student_Events se
JOIN 
    Ref_Event_Types ret ON se.event_type_code = ret.event_type_code
GROUP BY 
    se.event_type_code
ORDER BY 
    total_students DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(se.student_id) AS total_students, 
       se.event_type_code, 
       ret.event_type_description
FROM Student_Events se
JOIN Ref_Event_Types ret ON se.event_type_code = ret.event_type_code
GROUP BY se.event_type_code
ORDER BY total_students DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    COUNT(event_id) AS student_count,
    T1.event_type_code,
    T2.event_type_description
FROM 
    Student_Events AS T1
JOIN 
    Ref_Event_Types AS T2 ON T1.event_type_code = T2.event_type_code
GROUP BY 
    T1.event_type_code, T2.event_type_description
ORDER BY 
    student_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT se.student_id) AS total_students,
    se.event_type_code,
    ret.event_type_description
FROM 
    Student_Events se
JOIN 
    Ref_Event_Types ret ON se.event_type_code = ret.event_type_code
GROUP BY 
    se.event_type_code, ret.event_type_description
ORDER BY 
    total_students DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH EventCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        event_type_code, 
        COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS student_count
    FROM 
        Student_Events
    GROUP BY 
        event_type_code
)
SELECT 
    ec.event_type_code, 
    ret.event_type_description, 
    ec.student_count
FROM 
    EventCounts ec
JOIN 
    Ref_Event_Types ret ON ec.event_type_code = ret.event_type_code
ORDER BY 
    ec.student_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    se.event_type_code AS event_type_code,
    ret.event_type_description AS event_type_description,
    COUNT(DISTINCT se.student_id) AS total_students_joined
FROM 
    Student_Events se
JOIN 
    Ref_Event_Types ret ON se.event_type_code = ret.event_type_code
GROUP BY 
    se.event_type_code, ret.event_type_description
ORDER BY 
    total_students_joined DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    se.event_type_code,
    ret.event_type_description,
    COUNT(DISTINCT se.student_id) AS student_count
FROM 
    Student_Events se
JOIN 
    Ref_Event_Types ret ON se.event_type_code = ret.event_type_code
GROUP BY 
    se.event_type_code, ret.event_type_description
ORDER BY 
    student_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT

WITH RecursiveCTE AS (
    -- Base Case: Select documents where the owner is 'Marlin'
    SELECT Document_Object_ID, Parent_Document_Object_ID, Owner
    FROM Document_Objects
    WHERE Owner = 'Marlin'

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive Case: Find the parent of each document selected in the base case
    SELECT do.Document_Object_ID, do.Parent_Document_Object_ID, do.Owner
    FROM Document_Objects do
    INNER JOIN RecursiveCTE rcte ON do.Document_Object_ID = rcte.Parent_Document_Object_ID
)

-- Select distinct owners of the parent documents
SELECT DISTINCT Owner
FROM RecursiveCTE;

WITH lifespan AS (
    SELECT 
        artistID,
        CASE 
            WHEN deathYear IS NOT NULL THEN deathYear - birthYear
            ELSE 2023 - birthYear -- Assuming current year is 2023
        END AS lifespan_years
    FROM Artists
),
longest_lifespan_artist AS (
    SELECT artistID
    FROM lifespan
    WHERE lifespan_years = (SELECT MAX(lifespan_years) FROM lifespan)
)
SELECT COUNT(paintingID) AS num_paintings
FROM Paintings p
JOIN longest_lifespan_artist lla ON p.painterID = lla.artistID;

WITH ArtistLifespan AS (
    SELECT 
        artistID,
        (deathYear - birthYear) AS lifespan
    FROM 
        Artists
),
MaxLifespan AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(lifespan) AS max_lifespan
    FROM 
        ArtistLifespan
),
LongestLivingArtists AS (
    SELECT 
        artistID
    FROM 
        ArtistLifespan
    WHERE 
        lifespan = (SELECT max_lifespan FROM MaxLifespan)
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(paintingID) AS painting_count
FROM 
    Paintings p
JOIN 
    LongestLivingArtists lla ON p.painterID = lla.artistID;

    FROM Artists
    ORDER BY lifespan DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS longest_living_artist
JOIN Paintings ON longest_living_artist.artistID = Paintings.painterID;

WITH OilPaintings AS (
    SELECT p.painterID
    FROM Paintings p
    WHERE p.medium = 'oil'
),
ArtistOilPaintingCounts AS (
    SELECT a.artistID, COUNT(op.painterID) AS oil_painting_count
    FROM Artists a
    JOIN OilPaintings op ON a.artistID = op.painterID
    GROUP BY a.artistID
),
RankedArtists AS (
    SELECT artistID, oil_painting_count,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY oil_painting_count DESC) as row_num
    FROM ArtistOilPaintingCounts
)
SELECT artistID, oil_painting_count
FROM RankedArtists
WHERE row_num <= 3;

WITH OilPaintings AS (
    SELECT painterID, COUNT(*) as oil_paintings_count
    FROM Paintings
    WHERE medium LIKE '%oil%'
    GROUP BY painterID
),
MaxOilPaintings AS (
    SELECT MAX(oil_paintings_count) as max_oil_paintings
    FROM OilPaintings
)
SELECT A.fname, A.lname
FROM OilPaintings OP
JOIN MaxOilPaintings MOP ON OP.oil_paintings_count = MOP.max_oil_paintings
JOIN Artists A ON OP.painterID = A.artistID;

WITH OilPaintings AS (

    FROM Artists T1
    INNER JOIN Paintings T2 ON T1.artistID = T2.painterID
    WHERE T2.medium = 'oil'
    GROUP BY T1.artistID
),
MaxOilPaintings AS (
    SELECT MAX(oil_paintings_count) AS max_oil_paintings_count
    FROM OilPaintings
)
SELECT A.fname, A.lname
FROM Artists A
INNER JOIN OilPaintings OP ON A.artistID = OP.artistID
CROSS JOIN MaxOilPaintings MOP
WHERE OP.oil_paintings_count = MOP.max_oil_paintings_count;

WITH OilPaintings AS (
    SELECT p.painterID, COUNT(*) AS oilPaintCount
    FROM Paintings p

),

)

WITH TotalPrices AS (
    SELECT 
        r.ReceiptNumber, 
        SUM(g.Price) AS TotalPrice
    FROM 
        receipts r
    JOIN 
        items i ON r.ReceiptNumber = i.Receipt
    JOIN 
        goods g ON i.Item = g.Id
    GROUP BY 
        r.ReceiptNumber
),
MaxPrice AS (
    SELECT MAX(TotalPrice) AS MaxTotalPrice
    FROM TotalPrices
)
SELECT 
    tp.ReceiptNumber,
    r.Date
FROM 
    TotalPrices tp
JOIN 
    receipts r ON tp.ReceiptNumber = r.ReceiptNumber
WHERE 
    tp.TotalPrice = (SELECT MaxTotalPrice FROM MaxPrice);

WITH ReceiptCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        Date,
        COUNT(*) AS ReceiptCount
    FROM 
        receipts
    GROUP BY 
        Date
),
RankedDates AS (
    SELECT 
        Date,
        ReceiptCount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ReceiptCount DESC) AS Rank
    FROM 
        ReceiptCounts
)
SELECT 
    Date
FROM 
    RankedDates
WHERE 
    Rank <= 3;

)

FROM
